name: Alphonse Puthren
bio: Alphonse Puthren is an Indian film director, editor, writer, and commercial ad maker. He made his directional debut with the Tamil-Malayalam bilingual feature film Neram (2013). His second film was the blockbuster coming-of-age romantic film Premam (2015).
